Create a new ADR for: ${input:decision:Short decision title}

1. Read [docs/adr/README.md](../../docs/adr/README.md) and [the template](../../docs/adr/0000-template.md).
2. Use the next free 4-digit number and a kebab-case file name, e.g. `docs/adr/0005-versioned-metrics-output.md`.

5. Do not modify any other files.
